tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhung lugs rab 'byams pa smra ba'i mkhas pa legs pa chos 'phel gyis dris lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ na mo gu ra we/ zhing khams rnam dag ces bya'i 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bcom ldan klu yi rigs mchog rgyal po dang / /dbyer med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal nas/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho chen por legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /dgongs don gnad kyi yid bzhin nor bu mchog /mkhyen ldan blo gros lus bzang mdzes pa'i brgyan/ /tshig gi 'phreng bar spel 'di blang bar mdzod/ /shes bya'i tshogs la legs par sbyangs shing don gyi bcud rnam par nges pa'i mkhyen rab can legs pa chos 'phel bas/ phyi nang gi nyams len mang po'i don la dri ba'i tshul gnang byung ba la/ rnam grangs nyer lnga tsam gnang ba'i lan rnams ji ltar nus pa bstan par bya'o/ /zhes de la dri ba dang po ni/ gang zag dkri tshul la theg chen thun mong ma yin pa dang / theg pa thun mong ba dang / theg dman nyan rang gi lugs gsum du bshad kyang / theg pa thun mong ba zhes pa 'di/ theg chen gyi lam lnga sa bcu sogs/ gzhan don byang chub kyi sems rnams theg dman gyis khas mi len zhing / nyan rang gi dman pa brgyad/ rang don zhi ba don gnyer sogs theg chen gyis khas mi len pas/ theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs zhes pa 'di 'chad pa byung bas/ theg pa thun mong zhes pa'i go rgyu 'chang rgyu yod pa zhig dang zhes lan la gsum ste/ theg pa thun mong ba ngos bzung ba/ de lam bgrod tshul gsum gyi gang la ldan tshul/ de la chos gsum tshang bar bshad pas nges shes bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang sngags la ltos nas theg pa gzhan la thun mong ba zhes bya la/ de'i tshe theg pa che chung du 'dzin pa'i gang zag dag gis/ rang rang gi khyad chos las gzhan khas mi len par ma zad/ theg pa gnyis kyi 'phags pa rnams la skyon gyi dri ma gang la mnga' yang /

'phags pa las gcig shos su gyur pa nyan thos san+he pa la sogs pas/ theg pa chen po ni klu grub zer ba'i rdzus ma zhig gis byas so/ /zhes las ngan gsog pa dang / theg chen 'dzin pa kha cig gis/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni/ /pha rol phyin drug ming yang med/ /ces sogs kyis dmad nas phyogs 'dzin shin tu che bas/ gzhung chen mang por theg pa chen po bkar sgrub dgos 'dug pas/ de gnyis phan tshun ltos nas thun mong du 'jog pa ma yin pas/ theg chen gyi mdo phyogs yongs su rdzogs pa la 'jog cing / rgyu mtshan 'og nas 'byung lags so/ /gnyis pa ni mdo dang / sngags dang / gnyis po bsres nas lam bsgrod tshul rnams las/ mdo lam rkyang pa bgrod tshul ni/ rab dbye las/ 'on kyang theg pa chen po yis/ /zhes sogs ltar yin la/ 'di'i sa bcu'i tha mar bdud btul tshul la/ kha cig gis dus 'khor 'grel chen las 'byung ba'i nang gi 'pho ba'i bag chags bcom tshul dang / sbyor ba ni ma 'brel ba kho na ste/ mtshan mo'i zla ba skar ma dang bcas pa/ nyin mo nyi ma shar bas gsal bar byed do/ /zhes pa smra ba dang mtshungs pa'o/ /'o na ji ltar zhe na/ myang 'das chen po'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpas thog mar bdud bzhi bcom nas/ zhes gsungs te/ de'i thog mar bdud bzhi bcom tshul ni/ khyed rang phar phyin mkhyen pa yin pas rtogs par sla la/ sangs rgya khar bcom tshul ni/ ston pas byang chub shing drung du bzhugs nas bdud bskul ba la sogs pa'i rnam mthar rnams yin la/ lam 'dis su zhig grol ba'i mtshan gzhi ni/ ston pas mdo lam rkyang pa gsungs pas grol ba'i byang sems rnams yin pas/ slan chad rab dbye'i gzhung gi don 'di ltar thugs la bzhog mdzod/ sngags lam rkyang pas bgrod tshul ni/ dbang dang byin rlabs dang / de dag las byung ba'i lam gyis grol ba rnams yin la/ de'i mtshan gzhi ni/ rgya bod kyi grub thob pho mo bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams yin/

lam bsres pas bgrod tshul la/ mdo lam nas sngags la 'jug tshul shes dgos la/ 'di la kha cig na re/ tshogs lam chen po nas sngags la 'jug pa yin/ zhes smra ba la ni sgrub byed ci yang med cing / rang nyid kyis thog ma nas mdo sngags gnyis ka la zhugs shing / rjes 'jug rnams la yang gnyis ka bstan pas khas blangs 'gal ba'i skyon yod pas mi 'thad la/ don la gnas pa ni/ slob dpon lha'i 'byung gnas zla bas/ thabs shes grub pa zhes bya ba las/ sa bcu pa'i bar mdo lam rkyang pas bgrod de/ de nas sngags la 'jug par gsungs shing / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pa/ rje sa chen gyi lam bsre ba las/ kha cig sa dang po'i bar du pha rol tu phyin pas bgrod de/ de nas sngags la 'jug pa yang yod/ de bzhin du kha cig sa bdun pa'i bar dang / kha cig sa bcu pa'i bar du pha rol tu phyin pas bgrod nas/ de nas sngags la 'jug pa yang gsungs pas/ 'jug mtshams de dag du pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ lam lnga/ sa bcu sogs dang bsres nas bsgom pa rnams yin cing / 'di'i mtshan gzhi ni gdul bya rim gyis 'jug pa dang / gcig char 'jug pa'i gang zag rnams yin la/ nyams len 'di'i skabs kyi sems bskyed sogs rnams la/ mdo sngags thun mong ba zhes bya zhing / de'i shugs kyis theg chen gyi mdo sde rnams la yang / thun mong ba'i mtshan du btags pa'o/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor du nyan rang bkod pa rnams kyang / sngags lam dang gdul bya'i rigs la ltos nas thun mong du 'gyur ba lags so/ /gsum pa chos gsum tshang tshul la/ dgongs gzhi ni/ lam bsres pa mdo dang mthun pa'i nyams len gyis/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blang du rung zhing / len dgos pas de dag la spyi don nam thun mong zhes gsungs pa'o/ /dgos pa ni/ de ltar ma bstan na/ mdo lam la zhugs pa rnams/ rang gi lam la dman pa dang / 'bras bu med par dogs pa'i blo can rnams la 'gyod pa bzlog pa'i ched du gsungs pa yin pas/

slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ mdo sogs la ni rab zhugs pa'i/ /'gyod pa bzlog par byed pa dang / /zhes spyi don yin par gsungs shing / bka' srol gtsang ma brgyud pa'i gsung bgros las/ gtso bo nas ni me ri'i bar/ /gtso bo nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ /zhes gsung pas/ nyan rang bkod pa sogs kyang / de'i rigs can gyi gdul bya la 'gyod pa bzlog par byed pa'i thams lags so/ /dngos la gnod byed ni/ dri ma med pa'i lung 'og nas 'byung ba rnams so/ /dri ba gnyis pa ni/ yang don gcig na ma rmongs pa dang / zhes sogs slob dpon sde snod gsum pa'i tshul gsum sgron me'i lung 'di/ rang lugs sngags kyi yig cha phal cher du/ mdo las sngags khyad par 'phags pa'i shes byed du drangs 'dug pa nas/ thabs mang ba dang / dka' ba med pa sogs/ mdo las bla med khyad par du 'phags tshul du 'gro na'ang / rgyud sde 'og ma gsum mdo las khyad par du phags tshul du 'gro ba dka' ba 'dug pas/ 'og ma gsum mdo las khyad par du phags tshul du 'chad na ji ltar byed lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gnyis ste/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la khyad chos bzhi po tshang bar bstan bcos de nyid du bshad tshul dang / de gsum mdo las khyad par du 'phags tshul lung bzhin gyis bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung de nyid las/ mkhas pa snying rje che ldan pas/ /dpyad de thabs kyi mchog len cing / /tha mal pa yi thabs smad nas/ /mi 'pho ba yi gnas thob bo/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ zhes sogs nas/ don bsdu ba na/ 'di ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa las gsang sngags kyi sgo la spyad pa spyod pa rnams la rmongs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phar phyin la spyod pa rnams rmongs pa dang / gsang sngags pa rnams ma rmongs bar bshad do/ /khyad chos gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las/ sems can kun don legs bsgrub phyir/

/blo chen la ni thabs thams cad/ /dbye ba rnam bzhi'i tshul gyi mchog /'gro ba'i ston pa gsung pa yin/ /zhes dang / 'grel par tshul gzhan thams cad du ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dka' thub dang / sdom pa dang brtul zhugs la sogs pa mtho ris dang / thar pa thob pa'i thabs nyid yin par gsungs la/ sems can thams cad dka' thub dang sdom pa la sogs pa spyod par nus pa ma yin te/ zhes sogs nas/ don bsdu ba na/ de bas na bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal mkhyen pas sngags kyi bstan bcos rnam pa bzhi gsungs te/ gang yang re zhig skye ba gzhan du goms pa'i bag chags kyis/ skye bo med pa'i nags tshal gyi gnas dang / 'khrus dang / dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg dang / dka' thub dang / bzlas brjod la sogs pa'i bya ba med par yi mnyam par 'jog pa mi thob pas/ de'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud ston par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ 'di thabs mang ba'i dngos gzhi rgyud sde bzhi la mdzad pas 'og ma gsum la khyad chos mi ldan na thabs mang ba ngos 'dzin rgyu med par 'gyur lags so/ /khyad chos gsum pa ni/ de nyid las/ gang zhig gang du ji ltar 'dod/ /de nyid de la nges sbyor zhing / /'dod pa'i don thob mdzad pa yis/ /dam pa'i don ni thub pas gsung / /zhes dang / 'grel bar 'di ni gsang sngags kyi theg pa chen po'i lhag pa'i khyad par yin te/ sems can gang / yul gang du'am/ dus gang du/ ji ltar mngon par 'dod par 'gyur ba ste/ de nyid du nges par sbyor zhing thabs bde ba de nyid kyis byang chub thob par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes sogs nas/ don bsdu ba na/ de ltar sems can gang la mngon par 'dod pa de/ de nyid la nges par sbyor bar mdzad pas/ gtso bo sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas thob par mdzad pa'i phyir/ sngags kyi theg pa nyid dka' ba med cing byang chub kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin no/

/zhes gsungs so/ /khyad chos bzhi pa ni/ de bas dbang po rno gyur pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa ni thabs mkhas pas/ /ngan 'gro can gyi las rnams gang / /byed kyang dag pa thob par gyur/ /zhes dang / 'grel par/ 'dir bden pa de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyi thabs ma shes pa'i phyir/ dbang po brtul po yin par shes par bya'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ thabs nyid la 'khrul pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbang po 'bring pa yin no/ /gsang sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams ni gang du yang rnam par rmongs pa med pas na/ dbang po rnon po yin no/ /zhes sogs nas don bsdu ba na/ gsang sngags kyi sgo'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams ni dbang po rno ba nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mos pa dang mngon par brtson pa med pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lung gzhan gyis sgrub pa ni/ slob dpon dz+nyā na ā ka ras bya ba spyi'i sgrub thabs las/ dper na skyes bu stobs chung ba'am/ /phyugs kyi shing rtas yun ring gis/ /bgrod par bya ba'i gnas der ni/ /rkang mgyogs sgrub pa'am nyi zlas ni/ /myur ba nyid du bgrod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa 'am/ /lam gzhan dag la brten nas ni/ /yun ring 'jug par 'gyur ba der/ /sngags pas tshe 'dir 'jug pa ni/ /mnyam med mthu la brten phyir ro/ /zhes pas mdor bstan nas/ mnyam pa med pa'i mthu ni/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa la sogs pa gsum gyis rgyas par bshad cing khyad par 'phags par gsungs te/ de nyid kyi/ de la 'jug pa'i spyod pa ni/ /sngags la dad pa'i slob ma yis/ /bla ma yon tan ldan pa la/ /yun ring bsnyen pa sngon 'gro bas/ /bsnyen gnas gsol ba btab byas la/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug dang dbang bskur zhing / /rang gi 'dod lha bzung ba ste/ /de ni gzhi yi rkyen zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga'i sgo nas slob ma sngags kyi sdom ldan du byed pa 'di ni phar phyin theg par ma bshad pas/

khyad par du 'phags chos dang po yin la/ de bzhin du sgrub pa dang grub pa'i spyod pa yang gsal ba gsungs shing / phar phyin las rgyud sde 'og ma gsum khyad par du 'phags tshul shin tu rgyas par gsungs kyang 'dir mang bar dogs pas ma bris la/ mkhyen par 'dod na bya spyod kyi spyi rnam la sogs par zhib tu gzigs mdzod/ dri ba gsum pa ni/ don gcig na zhes pa yang gnas skabs lta ba gcig pa dang / mthar thug mdo sngags gnyis 'bras bu gcig pa la bshad par snang zhing / rab dbyer/ pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /zhes sogs/ mdo sngags kyi lta ba mtha' bzhi'i spros pa dang bral ba la mthun par bshad pa 'di dang / lam 'bras skabs su bum dbang gi zung 'jug gi lta ba dang / gsang dbang gi rang 'byung ye shes kyi lta ba dang / sher dbang dang dbang bzhi pa sogs kyi lta ba dug med bde stong ye shes kyi ngor skyes pa rnams spros bral med dgag gi lta bar ma byung bas/ 'di 'chad tshul ji ltar byed lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gsum ste/ mdo sngags don gcig pa'i tshul bshad pa rab dbye'i dgongs pa dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba don gcig tu bsgrub pa 'chad tshul/ gzhan dag rgyud kyi don ma yin par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshul gsum sgron mer/ mthar thug gi sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la bshad pa don ldan yin kyang / mdo sngags lta ba gcig pa de'i tshig zin la med cing / sa bcu gcig pa 'bras bu bshad pa de/ rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed srol la spyi don mthar thug tu gsungs la/ 'di la bka' rgyud pa kha cig dang / sa lugs pa kha cig gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go chod yin min rtsod pa'i lugs byas nas/ yig rul skur res mang du byas 'dug ste/ gnyis kas rgyud don ma rnyed par 'dug 'di nyid slob lam thun mong ma yin pa dang bcas pa la mtha' spyod rgyas par bya dgos te/ mang bas 'jigs pas bzhag la/ mkhyen par 'dod pas rdo rje 'chang gi zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa mtshams rnam par bzhag pa la gzigs rtogs gnang mdzod lags/

gnyis pa ni/ rab dbye las/ pha rol phyin pa'i zhes sogs gsungs pa'i sher phyin gyi lta ba mtha' bzhi'i spros bral du 'chad pa dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba bde stong zung 'jug du 'chad pa gnyis cung zad kyang mi 'gal te/ 'di ni bde stong zung du 'jag pa yin la/ de bzhin du bde stong lhan cig skyes pa/ bde stong gnyis su med pa/ bde stong dbyer med pa la sogs pa'i don yin la/ zung 'jug 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ spyod bsdus sgron me las lnga bcu lhag tsam gsungs shing / 'di'i don ston tshul la/ rgyud dang grub chen mang po'i gzhung las/ kha cig gis stong pa'i cha nas gsungs/ kha cig gis bde ba'i cha nas gsungs/ 'ga' zhig gis thabs so so'i cha nas gsung mod/ ngo bo zung 'jug ston pa la khyad par med la/ bde stong zung 'jug sogs khas blangs pa'i bde ba'i rang bzhin stong nyid spros bral yin pas/ 'di dang sher phyin gyi spros bral la spros bral yin min gyi khyad par rdul gyi nang nas rdul phra rab tsam yang med pas/ de skad gsungs pa yin no/ /'di la bde ba'i rang bzhin spros bral du mi 'dod na/ zung 'jug ces pa'i bde ba dang / zung du 'jug rgyu de gang yin/ lhan skyes zhes pa gang dang lhan cig skyes pa yin/ gnyis med ye shes kyang zung 'jug las cha so sor dbye ba med pas gnyis med yin la/ gang gi spangs bya'i grangs gnyis dang bral ba la/ gnyis med du 'dod pa ni/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma lags so/ /gsum pa ni/ zung 'jug dang lhan skyes sogs kyi rang bzhin stong par bshad pa la som nyi za ba dag gis ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod brtag gnyis las khyad chos drug ldan du gsung pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu zhes pa bsgom pa dang / bshad du mi rung zhing / mthar thug gi 'bras bu yan lag bdun ldan du gsung pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag ma tshang bas/ rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho las dgongs don gyi nor bu lon par rloms kyang rang rtog gis 'chings bu'i phreng ba blangs nas/

gzhan la ngom pa tsam du zad pas/ rgyud sde'i don la rgyab kyi phyogs lags so/ /mdor na gang zag gcig gis tshe gcig la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob tshul ni/ 'dren mchog kun dga' bzang po'i bstod pa 'jam dbyangs chos rjes mdzad pa las/ rba rlabs gsum gyi 'gros bzhi thim pas/ /bde stong zung 'jug mngon du gyur nas/ yan lag bdun ldan go 'phangs brnyes par/ zhes gsung pa 'di 'i 'bras dus kyi dbang gi mthar thug gi 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul bstan pa yin pas/ 'di la thugs rab zhib mos legs par dpyad nas/ tshig 'char gzhan gyi rjes su mi 'brang ba shin tu gal che lags/ dri ba bzhi pa ni/ dbang po rnon pos dbang byas nas/ /zhes pa yang / gang zag dbang po rab la/ gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul 'di dang / lam 'bras skabs su 'khrid kyi gzhung shing bzhi'i nang du/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi sgo nas lam 'bras bu dang bcas pas bkri bar mi nus pa'i gdul bya med par bshad pas dbang po brtul po yang sngags kyi lam du gdul byar mi 'gal tshul ji ltar lags zhes pa'i lan ni/ dbang po gsum gyis khrid yig 'dir/ lam 'bras kyi bkri bar mi nus pa sogs kyi tshig med cing / lam 'bras zin bris phyi ma kha cig tu/ de skad zer ba ni/ lam la che brjod byed par 'dod kyang ma shes par snang ste/ 'di nyid las brtul 'bring gnyis las rgyu 'bras sogs la thun mong bas bkri bar gsungs shing / rnon po la gsum du phye ste/ de re re la'ang gsum gsum du phye ste/ so so'i skal ba bzhin du sngags lam ston par gsung pas/ ma brtags pa shin tu phye ba yin lags/ spyir lam 'bras tsam la sngags lam kho nas ma khyab ste/ snang ba gsum gyi 'khrid bzhin no/ /kha cig gis snang ba gsum sngags lam du byas nas/ 'di'i sngon du rgyu dbang byed pa rnams ni rnam par 'chal pa'o/ /mdor na tshul gsum sgron mer/

phar phyin pa las sngags la spyod pa rnams khyad par du 'phags tshul gong du bstan pa ltar yin pas/ dbang po gsum gyi 'khrid yig dang 'gal ba'i skyon cung zad kyang med lags so/ /dri ba lnga pa ni/ bya spyod gnyis grub mtha' dang bkri na/ bye mdo gnyis mdo sde pa gtso che zhing / chags pa'i sgo nas kyang lta ba las rgod pa gtso che zhing / lag len gyi sgo nas kyang phyi gtsang sbra kho na dang / nang ting 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod pa'i bya rgyud las spyod rgyud khyad par du 'phags tshul mang dag gsungs kyang / cho ga'i 'chings stong yi ge'i sgra gzugs dang / phyag rgya mtshan ma lha drug ste/ zhes lha drug gi bsgom tshul gyi cho ga'i 'ching la/ bya spyod gnyis bya rgyud las spyod rgyud khyad par du 'phags tshul gtan ma phyed pas/ de gnyis kyi khyad par 'byed tshul zhig dang / zhes pa'i lan la gnyis te/ rgyud sde bzhi rang tshugs thub par bshad pa dang / bya spyod gnyis bsres nas 'chad pa'i lugs so/ /dang po ni/ rgyud sde mang po dang bstan bcos chen po du ma las/ rgyud sde bzhi so sor sgrub tshul nges pa'i lung shin tu mang bar yod de bri bar ma nus la/ zur tsam smras na/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /zhes sogs dang / yang dag par sbyor ba las/ rgod dang bltas dang lag bcang dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbye ba la nges pa rnyed pa zhig mdzad nas legs bshad smra ba la brtson par mdzod/ gnyis pa ni/ rgya gar du slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rtog pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ bdag gi rnal 'byor la lha drug gi bsdus par bshad pa 'di nyid kyis bya spyod gnyis ka'i nyams len bsdus par bzhed nas/ sgrub thabs kha cig la sbyor bar mdzad 'dug bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams la 'di ma byung yang /

phyi ma kha cig gis 'di legs po yin par dgongs nas/ bya rgyud kyi sgrub bskor kha cig la sbyor bar mdzad pa la/ gsang sngags mkhyen pa gzhan dag gis/ sangs rgyas gsang bas ni bya spyod gnyis bsres nas rgyud sde gsum du bzhed la/ bzhi ru bzhag pa'i phyogs la de mi rung ba yin zhes dpyad pa cung zad mdzad do/ /snga dus bsres pa'i nyams len de ka mdzad pa'i rgyun la/ deng sang lha drug gi rnam gzhag bdag gi rnal 'byor la gsungs pa ma go bar/ mdun bskyed la yod pa'i lha drug bdag bskyed la bsgom pa lo 'ga' zhig byung song / de ni de bas kyang 'jigs su rung ba rloms sems dang nga rgyal gyi nor dang ldan pa kha cig gis 'di'i sgrub skor gyi yi ge las/ 'di kho bos bla med ltar bkral ba ltar yin pas/ gtsang sbra la sogs pa mi dgos zer nas/ bya spyod kyi nyams len nag por btang ba 'dra ste/ gsal ches na mi dga' ba 'dug pas/ rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa la/ 'di 'thad mi 'thad dang / nyams len 'di legs sam nyes zhib tu dpyad pa gnang mdzod/ dri ba drug pa ni/ bya rgyud kyi chu dang cod pan gyi dbang / de steng du spyod rgyud la rdo rje dril bu'i dbang gsung par bshad pa 'di la/ bla med kyi chu dbang sogs sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi cha lugs med pas/ 'di rnams rang rkang gi dbang bskur lugs ji ltar byed lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gnyis ste/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi bab/ ye shes thig le las gsungs pa ltar bshad pa dang grub chen so sos rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ltar bshad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud sde so so la dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba bzhi gsung la/ de'i tshe bla med ma gtogs pa gzhan gsum la/ dbang dang lam gang gi skabs su yang sbyang gzhi sbyong ba'i rnam gzhag med par rgyud so so gzigs pas gsal ba/

kha cig na re/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi thun mtshams su rdo rje sems dpa' kho na'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam byed par rdo rje rtse mo las gsung pas sbyang gzhi sbyong ba dang snang ba lhar bsgom tshul grub zer ba ni/ rgyud de nyid kyi dgongs pa ma nges pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi dbang bskur tshul ni/ cho ga so so'i skabs kyi don 'gal rkyen sel ba dang / mthun rkyen sgrub par dgongs nas cho ga so so byed par lags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'o na de las gzhan bshad du mi rung ngam snyam na/ ma yin te/ rgyal ba'i dgong pas phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i grub chen rnams kyis/ rgyud gcig nyid kyang gzhan dang mthun par bkral ba yod de/ rdo rje rnam 'jom gyi rgyud las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba de zhes gsung pa la brten nas/ grub chen kha cig gis bya rgyud rang rkang gi tshul du bkral/ de bzhin du 'ga' zhig gis spyod rgyud dang / la las rnal 'byor rgyud/ gzhan gyis bla med ltar bkral ba yod pas gcig tu ma nges so/ /der ma zad mdo sde'i dgongs pa sngags su bkral ba yod de/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs dang / grub chen dā ri ka pas sher snying gi dgongs pa yum chen mo gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs su bkral ba bzhin no/ /de ltar bkral ba la ma dag pa'i dri ma yod/ ces smra bar 'dod pa ni ma yin lags so/ dri ba bdun pa ni/ chung 'bring lam dang sems nyid la gol/ zhes/ snang ba lhag pa'i lhar 'char ba bum dbang bskur ba'i lag rjes la/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyangs nas/ snang ba lha'i rang bzhin du 'char ba dang / tshogs lam che 'bring chung gsum las mi bgrod par bshad pa 'di dang / bum dbang gi rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang / slob dpon lta ci smos/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su yang sbyang gzhi phung po lnga'i steng du/ sbyang bya nyon mongs pa lnga sbyong ba la/ sbyong byed rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas/

sbyangs 'bras rgyal ba rigs lnga thob par bshad pa dang / der ma zad bir+wa la bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas sa drug gi rtog pa mngon du gyur tshul bshad pa dang mi 'gal tshul ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ chung 'bring sogs gsum ni theg pa 'og ma'i slob pa'i rim pa yin la/ 'di dang bskyed rim gyi nus pas snang ba lhar 'char ba la sogs pa 'og ma rnams ni 'gal ba'i don med cing / snang ba lhar 'char ba yang gang zag la ltos nas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa rnams la 'char ba yin la/ bum dbang thob tsam dang / bskyed rim bsgom pa la zhugs pa tsam la ni ma yin no/ /des na rig pa'i dbang gi skabs su sbyang gzhi phung po dang / sbyang bya nyon mongs pa rnams las/ dang po pa'i skabs su yod pas de rnams sbyong byed rigs lnga dang / sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga la sogs pa yin la/ de bzhin du drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i skabs su/ snga ma rnams la tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyangs dgos byung bas/ bskyed pa'i rim pas tha mal rnam rtog lhar bsgom pa dang mtshungs pa ma yin zhing / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bum dbang tsam thob pas sa drug thob pa ma yin te/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pas sa drug gi rtog pa brnyed pa yin la/ spyir dbang bskur bas grol ba la mchog dman gnyis las/ dang po ni/ in+d+ra bhu ti gsum gyi thog ma/ dbang thob pa tsam gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa brnyes par bshad pa dang gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug lta bu dbang gis grol ba'i dper byed pa yin la/ de nas dbang gis grol ba ni/ lam gyis grol ba tha dad pas 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /dri ba brgyad pa ni/ dbang bskur dang po ma thob par/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang / /zhes sogs bum dbang tsam bskur bas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang gi gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / rdo rje'i rba rlab sogs bsgom du mi rung bar/

mchog dbang phyi ma gsum bskur dgos pa bshad pa 'di dang / lus dkyil kyi dbang len pa'i tshe/ mi bskyod pa chu dbang bskur ba'i dus der/ dbang gi chu rgyun smin mtshams/ mgrin pa/ snying ka lus thams cad dbang gi chu rgyun gyis gang ba'i dus der/ dbang bzhi kar thob par bshad pas/ chu dbang thob pa'i dus der gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sogs rdzogs rim sgom pas e chog lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gnyis ste/ rab dbye'i dgongs pa bshad pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang bskur dang po sogs kyi don ni/ smin byed kyi dbang bzhi gtan nas ma thob par/ lam bskyed rdzogs bsgom du mi rung bar gsungs pa yin te/ dgag pa mdzad pa'i skabs der ma zad deng sang gi bar du/ phal cher gyis dbang bskur khas mi len zhing / khas blangs kyang dbang la ltos pa'i lam bsgom tshul shes pa nyin mo'i skar ma las dkon par gda'/ gnyis pa ni/ lus dkyil kyi dbang sogs ni rgyu lam phye ba'i lam gyi dus yin cing / de'i mi bskyod pa chu dbang la dbang bzhi tshang tshul dang / lam dus bsdus pa'i dbang bzhi len tshul dang / lam zab phyi nang gi dbang len tshul rnams ni/ smin byed legs par thob pa'i rgyun lam du thabs la mkhas pas gong 'phel du bya ba'i phyir nyams su len pa yin pas/ 'di dag la sdom pa gsar thob ni ma bshad pas/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la mi dbang lags/ 'dis mtshon nas rang lugs kyi phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ bde mchog sogs phyi dkyil so sor smin byed thob dgos par bzhed cing / phag mo'i byed du mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di lags so/ /dri ba dgu pa ni/ bla med kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa'i dus der/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi dbang ma thob kyang / bya spyod gnyis 'chad cing ston pa dbang ba dang / rnal 'byor rgyud 'chad pa la dbang bar bshad pa 'di dkyil 'khor de dang de nas bshad pa'i dbang ma bskur bas/

bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas pas/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi nyes bar mi 'gyur ba e yin lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ dkyil mchog mang por bshad pa de ltar 'byung yang / slob dpon gyi dbang gi ched du brjod pa tsam yin gyi/ sgra ji bzhin par bzung nas nyams su len pa'i rgyud dam pa gong ma'i phyag len la ma byung zhing / sgra ji bzhin 'dzin na ni/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas pa'i nyes pa bas kyang che ba/ thob bya gtan nas ma thob pa'i chos la bshad sgrub byas par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa 'byung ba lags so/ /dri ba bcu pa ni/ sam bu ṭi'i phyi mar gos zung gi dbang dang / mi g.yo bla med du ral gri'i dbang dang / ma rgyud 'ga' zhig tu he ru ka'i dbang dang / dus 'khor du cod pan gyi dbang zhes bla med spyi la ma grags pa'i zur pa 'di rnams la/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs dgos pa ji ltar yod lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa las/ gos zung gi dbang bshad pa gtan nas med cing / mi g.yo bla med du ral gri sbyin pa la sogs pa rnams ni dbang gi mtha' 'dogs sam/ rjes gnang khyad par ba yin pas/ dbang dngos ma yin zhing de dag la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed brtsi mi dgos shing / dus 'khor la ni mi mtshungs te/ de ni lus dag byed chu dang cod pan zhes pas/ dag bya dag byed sbyor rgyu yod lags/ dri ba bcu gcig pa ni/ dus 'khor gyi byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun la 'jig rten pa'i dbang zhes bshad cing lag len grub chen brgyad sogs srid rtse man gyi dngos grub thob par bshad cing / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub mi thob par bshad pa dang / dbang bskur lugs bla med spyi'i rig pa'i dbang dang 'dra zhing / chu dbang nas bzung dbang bdun pa bskur ba las/ sa bdun pa'i bar thob par gsung pa 'di 'gal 'jol shin tu che bar byung bas dbye gsal ji ltar lags/

zhes pa'i lan la gnyis te/ 'gal ba ltar snang yang 'gal med du sgrub pa dang / sgra ji bzhin par bzung ba 'gal tshab che bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud 'grel las/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gnyis su phye zhing / 'das pa'i dbang la che ba brjod nas/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang la dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba'i tshul gyis mchog mi thob par bshad pa ni dgongs pa ma nges pa rnams kyi brjod tshul tsam ste/ 'grel chen nyid las/ dbang bdun pa thob pas srog rtsol bsgom du rung bar gsungs shing / srog rtsol las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon gsum du byed na/ tshe 'di nyid la sa bdun gyi bar du thob par gsungs pas ni/ dbang bdun gyis mchog gi dngos grub thob pa dgag tu med cing / de las cung zad 'gyangs pas kyang skye ba phyi ma la sa thob par gsungs pas/ de dag ni gdul bya skal ldan gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ dbang dang srog rtsol la sogs pa'i lam rnams 'jig rten par byas nas mchog mi thob par bshad pa ni/ gdul bya skal dman gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ dpe gzhan tshol mi dgos par deng sang dus 'khor las zab pa'i chos med ces kha 'dzin byed pa rnams kyis dngos grub ji ltar thob gzigs pas gsal/ de bzhin du dus 'khor las gsungs pa'i dbang gong ma ni nges don yin/ bla med gzhan las gsungs pa'i dbang bzhi pa ni drangs don yin ces pa yang dgongs pa ma nges pa ste/ de ltar na dus 'khor 'phags yul du ma dar ba'i gong du grub thob ji snyed byon pa rnams la dbang bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa thob rgyu dang / de'i lam rnam dag bsgom rgyu med pas/ de dag grub thob ma yin par 'gyur ba sogs nyes pa shin tu che'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos bstan de ltar gsungs pa sgra ji bzhin par 'dzin na/ dgongs pa ma shes pa'i skyon shin tu che ste/ 'grel chen las/ 'phags lam sa bcu gnyis su mdzad pa la dbang bdun gyis ni sa thob par mi nus pas/

rgyud de'i lugs la sa brgyad pa nas bcu gcig pa'i bar slob lam du 'gyur zhing / bcu gnyis pa mi slob lam du mdzad par snang bas/ bla med spyi las sa'i rnam gzhag shin tu dman par 'gyur la/ 'grel pa'i tshig nyid kyang don ldan du bshad du mi rung bas 'gal tshab che zhing che bar 'gyur lags so/ /dri ba bcu gnyis pa ni/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas byed pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma'i sku 'dra ji ltar yin kyang / tha mal pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi steng du/ sbyang bya nyon mongs lnga sbyong byed dbang lngas sbyong ba sogs/ smin byed kyi dbang yang ni ma yin/ sngar ma thob pa bskur ba'i smin zin gong 'phel yang ma yin/ rtsa ltung sogs nyams rgyu ma byung bas nyams pa phyir bcos kyi dbang yang ma yin pas/ de rnams kyi bskur lugs go ba sogs shin tu gsal ba cig dang / zhes pa'i lan ni/ rab gnas rten la dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa de nas gsung pa gsum ni rtsi rgyu med kyang / rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan gcig gis byed dgos pas/ rten gang yin lha dam tshig par bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug de la dbang bskur zhing rab gnas byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag pa dag gi dad pas bsod nams gsogs pa'i rten du sgrub pa yin pas/ 'di la kha cig lha'i skur ma bskyed par rab gnas mi chags zer/ kha cig chags zer ba ni don med yin te/ lhar ma bskyed par rab gnas byed pa med pas so/ /de bzhin du rten la dbang bskur bas sdom pa sar thob yod med rtsod pa yang / bskyed bya lha'i ngos nas gzhal na/ sdom pa med pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems mi srid pas sdom ldan du bya dgos la/ rab gnas skabs kyi dbang de las/ sdom pa sar thob ni ma bshad pas/ don med kyi rtsod par mchis so/ /dri ba bcu gsum pa ni/

dus 'khor gyi skye dgu'i bdag po'i dbang kho na thob pas rgyud sde gzhan rnams kyi dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud 'chad pa dang man ngag ston pa la dbang bar bshad pa 'di/ tshad ldan du byas na/ dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma thob tsam gyis rgyud sde thams cad kyi dbang rgyun lung rgyun sogs yod pa bzhed lags sam/ med na ni/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /ces sogs dang 'gal zhing / dus 'khor rang la yang bskur ba btab par 'gyur bas phye gsal yod pa gcig dang / zhes pa'i lan la gnyis te/ dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i dbang gi che brjod la 'khrul tshul dang / de lung rnam dag dang 'gal tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bdag po'i dbang la che ba brjod pa 'di dang / slob dpon a bha yas mdzad zer ba'i man ngag snye ma chung ba la brten nas/ bod 'chal pa kha cig gis/ dbang bskur gcig gis kun thob zer ba'i grub mtha' bcas shing / de yang kho bos ni dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las thob pas gcig rgyud yin la/ kho bo las thob pa rnams ni gnyis rgyud la sogs pa yin zhes smra ba la/ mkhas grub du mas lung rigs kyi dgag pa mdzad pas/ lag len gyi rgyun chad kyang / brjod pa'i rgyun ni da dung ma chad par snang ngo / /yang kha cig na re/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi lha phal cher tshang bas/ dkyil 'khor der dbang thob na gcig gis kun thob tu 'gyur zer te/ 'di yang mi 'thad pa'i tshul ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus 'khor gyi che brjod de la brten nas/ rgyud sde kun gyi dbang thob pa ni/ rgya bod gang du yang dus 'khor la mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag rgyun la med lags/ yod par 'dod pa dag ni lung du ma dang 'gal te/ phag mo sngon 'byung / mi g.yo ba bla med/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud rnams tshig mthun par/ dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs la/ /rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor gzhan du bzhugs pa la'ang /

/rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la brten nas bsgrub par 'dod pa rnams kyang rang gzhung dang 'gal te/ slob dpon dza ya se nas mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil chog las/ rdo rje theg pa'i tshul chen la/ /rang rang dkyil 'khor la bzhugs par/ /sgrub par 'dod pa ma yin phyir/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis/ /dbang bskur rim pa skyon med pa/ /bla ma'i man ngag bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ lung 'di rnams kyi don dgongs na dag ma dag dang / phyag chen thig le'i lung dang 'gal mi 'gal mkhyen par 'gyur lags/ dri ba bcu bzhi pa ni/ khyad par bla med kyi dbang len pa'i tshe/ slob dpon/ dkyil 'khor/ slob ma/ dbang thams cad 'pho ba dang / dbang 'pho la slob ma mi 'pho ba dang / de bzhin du dkyil 'khor mi 'pho la slob ma dbang rdzas sogs 'pho ba dang / dbang rdzas 'pho la gzhan mi 'pho ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag 'di rnams mtshan gzhi so so ba gcig lam dus kyi skabs su khyad shin tu che ba yong 'dug pas/ mtshan gzhi so so ba gsal ba gcig mkhyen/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ rnal 'byor bla med gzhir bzhag gi dbang len pa la/ slob dpon la sogs pa thams cad 'pho ba ni dkyil chog phal cher la snang la/ dbang 'pho la slob ma mi 'pho ba ni/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang la/ slob ma gtso bo'i nga rgyal kho nas gnas pa la dbang rnams rim pa bzhin bskur ba yin la/ dkyil 'khor mi 'pho la/ slob ma dbang rdzas sogs 'pho ba yang phal cher la yod cing / khyad par kyai rdor dkyil 'khor phyi nang gnyis gang yin kyang so sor gnas shing / gur las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbang bskur bya/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa chu dbang gi skabs su slob dpon yang mi 'pho la/ dbang rdzas dang slob ma rim pas 'pho ba lta bu'o/ /dbang chog gcig la rnam grangs sbyar ba ni ma mthong lags/ dus deng sang lam dus kyi ming 'don mkhan yang dkon par snang yang de bas lam dus chag med du mdzad pa la rjes su yi rang lags/

dri ba bco lnga pa ni/ bdag gis lam 'bras tshar gsum tsam thob cing / aṣ+ṭa'i bsnyen chen sbyin sreg dang bcas pa song bas/ gsang sgrogs ma byung tsam e yong na/ mi yong tshe brda lnga bsdus rtse mos gnon pa dang / e la reg byed dang / byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang / mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa sogs la brda 'gro la thugs rje che ba gcig mkhyen/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ khyed kyis lam 'bras gsan pa sogs kyai rdor chos bskor la zhib cha 'thon pa mdzad 'dug pas/ gsang sgrog mi yong ba 'dug kyang / sngon gyi rje btsun gong ma slob tshogs dang bcas pa'i bka' srol la/ lam 'bras thob nas cha lag rnams ston pa yin cing / khyad par du dbang gi brda rnams gcig rgyud du ston pa la/ brda chig brgyud zhes pa bla ma mkhas pa'i drung du thob dgos kyang / deng sang lam 'bras la mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can dag rgyu dbang gi dus su phyag rgya rnams bcas nas/ bshad pa byed cing 'dug pas/ lam 'bras kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i rtags su gda'/ des na bdag gi brda' rnams la yig rigs su bkod kyang / don chung la nyes pa che ba gcig 'byung ba 'dug pas ma bris shing / phyogs tsam mkhyen par 'dod na/ bar skabs su 'byung ba'i gzhung bshad man ngag gi mdzod la sogs par bris 'dug pas/ de rnams la gzigs mdzod/ de dag kyang mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung sgros la thal ches pa'i cho le bar mdzad cing gda' lags/ dri ba bcu drug pa ni/ ri bo dge ldan par ma zad pa'i lung stag tshang lo tsā sogs kyang / bya spyod gnyis la byang sdom las lhag pa'i sngags sdom 'dzin rgyu med par bshad pa ni/ bla ma gong ma'i yig char/ dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sdom pa bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum dang 'brel ba'i sdom pa gsum/ zhes sogs bya spyod la sngags sdom yod par bshad pa dang mi 'gal ba e yin lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ phyogs snga ma des ni rgyud sde bzhi la rang bzo'i cho ga kho na byed pa yin pas/

bya spyod la sdom pa bsrung rgyu med par 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad/ phyogs phyi ma ni/ stag tshang du gnas kyang wa skad rang shugs la shor ba yin te/ snga ma de'i rjes bzlos smra ba tsam las rgyu mtshan ci yang med pas so/ /phyogs snga gnyis pos kyang bya spyod la dbang bzhi khas mi len la/ 'o na bya spyod la sngags sdom ji ltar zhe na/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bya rgyud kyi sdom pa bcu gsum/ rnam snang mngon byang las spyod rgyud kyi sdom pa bzhi gsung pa rnams de dag gi rna ba'i bu gar yang ma thos pas/ gsang sngags shes pa'i grangs su 'gro ba ma yin lags/ sdom pa de dag gi grangs dang 'bru snon 'dir brisan mang bar 'gyur bas bzhag la/ don du gnyer na bya rgyud spyi rnam legs bshad rgya mtsho la sogs par gzigs 'tshal/ dri ba bcu bdun pa ni/ rab dbyer/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ /dbang bskur med par thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes rang gi rgyu'i dbang bskur ba ma thob par/ sngags sdom mi thob par bshad pa 'di dang / rgyud las sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /e waṃ rnam par yang dag gnas/ /zhes don dam pa bde chen gyi sdom pa rnams bsgom pa'i stobs kyis skye/ dbang chog gi sgo nas mi skye bar bshad pa 'di dang mi 'gal ba'i tshul ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ rab dbye las gsungs pa ni/ las dang po pa sdom ldan du sgrub pa dbang chog la ltos pa yin la/ bde chen gyi sdom pa sogs ni/ bstan pa thob nas rim gyis skye ba yin pas/ dus dang gang zag la ltos pas 'gal ba cung zad kyang med lags/ dri ba bco brgyad pa ni/ de bzhin du sta gon gyi skabs su/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum rdo rjer byin gyis rlabs pa'i tsheg sdom pa thob par bshad pas/ 'di sngags sdom mam/ byang sdom gang du bzhed lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ slob ma mngal du bskyed pa'i lha'am ma bskyed kyang / de'i gnas gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis rlabs pa nas/

sngags sdom gyi go 'dzin pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan slob ma'i sgo gsum tha mal du 'dzin pa las bzlog pa'i thabs kyis rnyed pa yin pas so/ /dri ba bcu dgu pa ni/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi dus kyi rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig sogs rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig nyi shu bsrung ba de rnams sngags sdom du bzhed dgos pa 'dra lags/ de rnams sngags sdom du mi bzhed na ni/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa de rnams 'dzin pa la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung zer ba yin lags sam/ sngags sdom gcig 'dzin rgyu ma byung na ni/ sdom bzung zhes smos pa la dgos pa ma byung zhing / dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i sdom pa ni ma skyes pas ji ltar byed lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig gnyis ka yang sngags sdom yin la/ 'dzin pa'i skabs kyang dkyil chog kha cig las sta gon gyi skabs su gsungs/ kha cig las dngos gzhi'i 'jug pa'i skabs su gsungs te/ gnyis ka'i dgos pa yang / dbang gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga las thob par 'gyur ba de 'dzin par khas blangs pa yin pas khas blangs gi sdom pa zhes bya la/ 'di la legs rtog ni gong du smos pa'i gsang sngags rang bzor spyod pa des ni/ sta gon gyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum byas pas/ sngags sdom yongs su rdzogs pa thob rjes bya ba la mkhas pa rnams kyis dgag pa mdzad cing / don la gsang sngags mi shes pa'i rtags de kas bstan pa yin te/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung med pa'i sta gon du ma bshad pas/ phyogs de la sngags sdom bstan nas thob rgyu med pa sogs skyon gyi phung por snang ngo / /dri ba nyi shu pa ni/ khyad par rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur gyi tshe/ rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng / dkyil chog rdor phreng /

sbyin sreg 'od kyi 'phreng ba ste/ phreng ba skor gsum gyi rjes su 'breng ba yin zer/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rdo rje dbyings gtsug dgu sogs dang / spyod rgyud kyi 'byung 'dul gyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed dang / bya rgyud rig pa'i rgyal mo dang rnam rgyal 'od zer can ma sogs la/ bla med kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang sbyar nas bskur cing 'dug pa 'di/ rgyud sde bzhi yi sgrub pa yang / /'khrul par byas pa dngos grub rigs/ /zhes rab dbyer bshad pa dang / dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes pa dang mi 'gal ba e yin lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur la/ snga mo dar dus nas sa bzang 'phags pa ma byon bar la/ phreng ba'i dngos bstan dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis yin lags/ 'phags pas bal po mahā bo dhi la gsan pa'i phreng ba dang mthun par/ kri ya sa muñtsa'i dbang rgyun yang gsan pas/ de la phreng bar med pa'i dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum bsnan pas bzhi bcu zhe lnga byung / phreng ba dngos bstan gyi dkyil 'khor rdor dbyings sogs la phyi drug gi dkyil 'khor tha snyad dge legs su byed pa gsum dang bcas pa'i rgyud sde phyi ma dgu'i dbang 'dren mchog kun dga' bzang po la bka' bab tshun chad/ dbang bzhi la sogs pa'i 'chol pa de 'dra mi mdzad pa 'dug pas/ khong byed mkhan tsho la gsung rgyu yin na'ang 'dir thal 'dug khong dag la gsungs kyang rab dbye la rtsis 'jog mi byed pa 'dra lags/ dri ba nyer gcig pa ni/ mdor na pha rol tu phyin pa lta ci smos/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po rang rkang la yang sangs rgyas dngos su thob pa med de/ de rnams su dbang gsum pa'i 'khor 'das bsre ba'i rnam gzhag med cing / de med par bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye mi nus/ de ma skyes par spang bya 'pho ba'i bag chags spong mi nus/

de ma nus par sangs rgya bar mi nus pa 'di chos rje sa skya pa'i grub mtha'i gtso bor/ des na 'khor 'das bsre ba'i phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa'i spyod/ /nang gi sa lam kun bgrod nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum pa ni thob par gyur/ /zhes rab dbyer bshad pa dang / rang rang gzhung bzhin byed na ni/ /de las gsung pa'i dngos grub 'byung / /zhes rgyud sde bzhi po rang rang gi gzhung bzhin sgrub na mchog gi dngos grub thob par bshad pa 'di dang / rnal 'byor rgyud du bsam gtan gyi spyod bsgom byas/ de nas mngon byang lnga las langs nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur 'og min du longs sku mngon du byed par bshad pa dang mi 'gal tshul ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gsum ste/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi sangs rgyas thob tshul bshad pa dang / bla med kyi lam bgrod tshul bshad pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sangs rgyas thob tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas yin na bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin pas ma khyab pas/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyis sangs rgyas thob par mi nus te/ de yang bya ba'i rgyud kyi thob tshul ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta mu tā ka ras mdzad pa las/ sgrub pa po'i tha mal gyi lus rten 'di nyid kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus rten thob la/ rig 'dzin gyi rten des phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas las gdams ngag thob nas sangs rgya bar bshad la/ de bzhin du spyod rgyud dang / rnal 'byor rgyud du tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgya bar dngos su gsung la/ sangs rgyas de yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal lung las/ rang gi rjes mthun byang chub bla dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sa bcu gcig pa la sangs rgyas su byas pa bla byas kyi sangs rgyas thob pa yin pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab dbye las gsung pa'i sa lam bgrod tshul ni/ skal ldan tshe gcig lus gcig gis bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/

sangs rgyas kyi thob tshul de ltar shes na 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /gsum pa ni/ rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pa la/ dpal de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa rgyud kha cig bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du/ ston pa 'di nyid mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas gsungs pa yin la/ sangs rgyas gzhan dang rang nyid kyi sprul sku gzhan gyis gsungs par bshad la/ rgyud de nas bsam gtan la sogs pa nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshul gyi bar rnams rgyud gzhan la sbyar du med mod/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis sprul sku shākya'i rgyal po'i mdzad pa sbyar nas/ dkar spyod pa yan chad rang rgyud pa dang de nas lam rim gyis bgrod nas/ sangs rgyas par bshad la/ grub chen kun snying la sogs pas mi 'thad par gsungs pa'i dgag sgrub 'phags yul du'ang byung bas dmigs bsal du mdzad na legs so/ /dri ba nyer gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mngon byang lnga dang / bla med nas bshad pa'i mngon byang lnga po 'di phyi nang gang la sbyar kyang mi 'dra ba mang dag 'dug pas khyad par ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gnyis te/ mngon byang lnga don spyir bstan pa dang / nang gi mngon byang bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mngon byang la sogs pa/ thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed zhes bya ba yin pas/ khams dkar dmar gyi bde ba lam du byed mi nus par bshad la/ bla med nas bshad pa rnams la nang gses kyi dbye ba cung zad yod kyang / 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa zhes bya ba rgyu ā li kā lis mtshon pa'i byang sems dkar dmar gyi bde ba lam du byed nus pas/ khyad par ni de dag yin la/ de gnyis mi mthun pa shin tu che bas phan tshun sbyar du mi rung zhing / de gnyis ka yang phyi'i mngon byang zhes pa'i grangs su byed pa lags/ gnyis pa nang gi mngon byang ni/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs nye rgyu la brten nas/

nang gi byang sems kyi sbyor ba la bshad pa yin te/ de skad du/ de la thabs gnyis la brten byang sems kyi/ /dwangs ma mngon du byas pa las byung ba'i/ /thig le zla ba me longs ye shes dang / /rak+ta nyi ma mnyam pa nyid ye shes/ /rlung sems ma 'dres yong rdzogs so sor rtog /thams cad ro gcig bya ba nan tan che/ /g.yas g.yon dbus nas 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab so sor dag byas te/ /dbu mar thim pa'i gtsug tor mchog grub pa'i/ /skad cig gcig la zag med 'ja' lus dang / /rtog med ye shes brnyes pa chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes gsung pa la mkhyen rab zhib mos legs par gzigs mdzod/ dri ba nyer gsum pa ni/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis kyi grangs gsal gcig mkhyen/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ sngon gyi dus su rje btsun gong ma slob mar bcas pas/ gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab thugs la bzhag nas/ rnam mthar rnams gsang gang thub mdzad pas rang ngam slob ma sus kyang / de'i lo rgyus khung thub kyi yi ge med cing / bar skabs su ngos 'dzin 'dra byung 'dug ste/ de la yang yid ches kyi dka' ba 'dug rang lugs kyi cung zad dag gi bsam pa la gung ru'i ngos 'dzin zhig byung 'dug glo bo mkhan chen pas kyang byung 'dug ste/ de gnyis ka nas sam+bu ṭi'i 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed las/ rgyu 'di'i rgyud sde mang po gsal bar byed pa'i phros don dang sbyar nas/ de nyid 'dus pa sogs kyang bgrang 'dug pa ni/ bla med phyogs ni zhes rtsa tshig dang 'gal bar snang zhing / lkog 'gyur 'di 'dra'i rigs la rang gi tshod dpag byed du mi rung lags so/ /dri ba nyer bzhi pa ni/ byang chub sems ni spong ba zhes pa/ rang lugs la don dam byang chub sems gtong ba la byas na/ kun da byang chub kyi sems la byas pa'i tshe/ sa chen mar pa lo tsā sogs khyim pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la rtsa ba'i ltung ba phog pa'i nyes pa yod par bshad pa 'di dang /

'grel chen dri med 'od dang dpal ldan bla ma'i gzhung bshad man ngag gi mdzod du/ gsang dbang gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig la kun da byang chub kyi sems la bshad 'dug pa dang / gong gi 'grel chen du yang / byang chub sems ni gtong zhes pa/ kun da byang chub kyi sems la bshad 'dug pas/ des na khyim pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la rtsa ba'i ltung ba e byung lags/ zhes pa'i lan la gsum ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa bshad pa/ bla med spyi'i dgongs pa ji ltar yin tshul/ khyim pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dmigs bsal du bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ltung lnga pa 'di la/ 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba dag snang ste/ dus 'khor gyi zhal 'dzin mdzad pa rnams ni/ rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni kun da byang sems yin pas de spong ba ni ltung ba lnga pa yin zhes mgrin cig tu sgrogs par mdzad/ de ni rgyud kyi dngos bstan dang mthun zhing / 'di'i lugs la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyi steng du/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs zhes pa khams 'pho ba med pa la bshad nas/ tshogs gsum yongs su rdzogs pas 'bras bu dus 'khor thob par bshad pas/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs rdzogs pa la khams 'pho ba med pa nges par dgos pas/ bshad lugs 'di yang shin tu legs pa zhig yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud dang / rdo rje gur la sogs pa las/ chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /zhes pa'i don gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'grel pa grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa dang / slob dpon shan+ti bas mdzad pa las/ chos kyi rtsa ba kun rdzob byang chub sems smon 'jug gnyis la bshad cing / rdo rje gur gyi dgongs pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bshad srol la yang de bzhin du 'byung ba ni/ rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin pas rtsa ltung 'khrul spong la sogs par gzigs pas gsal/

'o na de gnyis 'gal lo snyam na/ gnas skabs su tshig gi spros pa 'gal ba ltar snang yang / don la 'gal ba med de/ bla med gzhan gyi lam la yang 'dzag med kyi bde ba sgrub dgos pa kun da byang sems spong du mi rung zhing / dus 'khor lugs la rtsa ltung lnga pa bsrung ba yang smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis bsdus pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ dus 'khor ltar na khams dkar cha spangs pa rtsa ltung du gsung kyang / dmigs bsal la khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la rigs kyi sras bskrun pa dang / gsang dbang yum la brten nas thob pa'i phyogs la dbang rdzas dngos su sgrub dgos pas/ byang sems gtong ba la ltung ba med par gsung lags so/ /dri ba nyer lnga pa ni/ lam sogs chos nyi shu'i skabs su shes dbang dang dbang bzhi pa'i grub mtha' la rgya che chung gi khyad par bshad pa 'di/ zhu bde lhan skyes dang rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi sgo nas khyad par 'byed dam/ de min khyad par 'byed chos ji ltar yod lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ dbang gnyis kyi grub mtha' lhan skyes gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jog pa ma yin te/ zhu bde lhan skyes ni dbang gong ma gnyis ka la yod cing / gang zag re re'i rgyud la brtsi ru rung bas rgya chung la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin pas rgya che ste/ brtag gnyis las lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa/ /lhan skyes pa der brjod par bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes shes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa cig /ces dang / rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu ti'i lhan gcig skyes grub las/ gang dang mtshungs pas skyes gyur pa/ /des na lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /zhes pa'i lung gong 'og gnyis po 'dis ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis spros bral du bstan pa yin mod/ dbang gnyis kyi grub mtha' 'char ba'i rgyur ma gsungs so/ /dbang gnyis kyi grub mtha' 'char ba'i rgyu ni rang rang gi lam la sogs pa yin pas/
